subject: Jensen wants to return 🔙, NVIDIA board says no 🚫, Tesla's Powercore ⚡

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia
stories.quote: ISOMORPHIC LABS RAISES $5B TO SCALE ITS ISODDE DRUG-DESIGN ENGINE AND FOUNDATIONAL BIOLOGY MODELS TOWARD CLINICAL TRIALS
stories.description: Alphabet-backed company building a drug-design engine and foundational biology models

facts.text: Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, six months after a $2.1 billion Series B
facts.quote: The Alphabet-backed company raised a Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, six months after a $2.1 billion Series B

facts.text: Bloomberg earlier reported a roughly $50 billion valuation (not stated as this round's valuation)
facts.quote: Bloomberg earlier reported a roughly $50 billion valuation

facts.text: Partners include Eli Lilly, Novartis and Johnson & Johnson; positive preclinical results reported in oncology and immunology
facts.quote: Isomorphic reports positive preclinical results in oncology and immunology, with partners including Eli Lilly, Novartis, and Johnson & Johnson.

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs raised a $2.1B Series B six months earlier
stories.quote: The Alphabet-backed company raised a Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, six months after a $2.1 billion Series B, and Bloomberg earlier reported a roughly $50 billion valuation.
stories.description: Alphabet-backed company building a drug-design engine and foundational biology models

stories.headline: Genesis AI raises $500M at a $3.5B valuation to build its Eno wheeled robot
stories.quote: GENESIS AI RAISES $500M AT $3.5B TO BUILD ENO, A HEADLESS WHEELED ROBOT WITH IN-HOUSE ACTUATORS, GEARBOXES, AND HANDS
stories.description: Builds Eno, a headless wheeled robot with in-house actuators and hands

stories.headline: Marvell's $3.5B acquisition of Celestial AI cited as source of its photonic memory module
stories.quote: Marvell's module, from its $3.5B Celestial AI acquisition, stacks 72 GB of HBM3e and eight DDR5 channels on a silicon photonic interposer with 900 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth.
stories.description: Silicon photonic interposer technology for memory modules

stories.headline: Jensen Huang says he would return as Nvidia CEO if the board wants; board source says no plans to reinstate him
stories.quote: In his first statement since resigning, Jensen Huang said he made serious mistakes, will cooperate with the board's independent investigation, and would return if the board decides it serves shareholders and the company.

facts.text: Nvidia formed an executive committee on export control compliance; Huang to testify before Congress on December 1
facts.quote: Nvidia has formed an executive committee to oversee export control compliance, and Huang will testify before Congress on December 1.

facts.text: Board source told the Washington Post there are no plans to reinstate him
facts.quote: A source on Nvidia's board told the Washington Post that there are no plans to reinstate him, and one senator called the idea among the worst he'd heard.

stories.headline: Nvidia Q3 revenue $115.8B; Q4 guided to $130B with no China data center revenue; board rules out Huang's return
stories.quote: Nvidia's Q3 revenue hit $115.8 billion, with data center up 110% to $107.6 billion and Vera Rubin NVL72 racks shipping to CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Azure, Oracle, and Nebius.

facts.text: Q4 guidance $130B plus or minus 3%, assuming no China data center compute revenue; gross margin 71% to 72%
facts.quote: Q4 guidance of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%, assumes no China data center compute revenue, and gross margin dips to 71% to 72%.

facts.text: Board chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Huang; a search firm leads the CEO search
facts.quote: On the call, board chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, and a search firm is leading the CEO hunt.

stories.headline: Waymo halts freeway rides in all 15 cities after California DMV restricts its freeway operations
stories.quote: California's DMV restricted Waymo's freeway operations on November 11 after three robotaxis entered an active construction closure on US-101 near Burlingame and a separate incident involved CHP vehicles on Highway 280.

facts.text: Freeway service halted in every market; surface-street rides, over half a million trips a week, continue
facts.quote: Waymo has halted freeway service in every market while it evaluates performance, and surface-street rides, over half a million trips a week, continue.

facts.text: DMV calls it an imminent hazard; similar incidents on May 18 led to a prior restriction
facts.quote: The DMV calls it an imminent hazard, since similar incidents on May 18 led to a prior restriction and fixes.

stories.headline: Tesla's Powercore combines transformer, inverter and breaker in one 7.4 MW solid-state unit
stories.quote: TESLA'S POWERCORE PACKS TRANSFORMER, INVERTER, AND BREAKER INTO ONE 7.4 MW SOLID-STATE UNIT, TAKING ON HERON LINK

facts.text: Rated 7.4 MW (9 MVA) continuous at 34.5 kV, made in the US, operating in 2027
facts.quote: It's rated 7.4 MW (9 MVA) continuous at 34.5 kV with grid-forming support up to 10 MVA peak, made in the US, operating in 2027.

facts.text: About 50% more than the 5 MW Heron Link from Drew Baglino's startup; Tesla has not shared efficiency or pricing
facts.quote: That's about 50% more than the 5 MW Heron Link from ex-Tesla exec Drew Baglino's startup, which claims 98.6% efficiency, a Morgan Hill factory, and customers like Vantage and Intersect. Tesla hasn't shared efficiency or pricing.

stories.headline: Marvell and Penguin photonic memory appliance pools 16 TB of DDR5 and 1 TB of HBM across 16 servers
stories.quote: MARVELL AND PENGUIN'S PHOTONIC MEMORY APPLIANCE POOLS 16 TB OF DDR5 AND 1 TB OF HBM ACROSS 16 SERVERS OVER OPTICAL LINKS

facts.text: Systems due in the second half of next year
facts.quote: An HBM cache-through mode gives HBM speed with DDR5 capacity, aimed at KV cache offload, with systems due in the second half of next year.

stories.headline: ULA says Vulcan's first-stage booster lost performance and Centaur could not recover; BE-4 under review
stories.quote: ULA says the solid boosters were nominal and the problem began in the first stage, while Centaur's RL-10C engines did their job but couldn't make up the loss.

stories.headline: Apple adds front-camera face unlock for the iPhone Duo in iOS 27.3 beta 2
stories.quote: IPHONE DUO'S THIN FOLDABLE BODY HAS NO ROOM FOR A TRUEDEPTH ARRAY, SO APPLE ADDS FRONT-CAMERA FACE UNLOCK IN IOS 27.3 BETA 2
